purpose: Teach: 緑化/痙攣/嘔吐/度数/積分/水蒸気/骨髄/流暢

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、オフィスの緑化を進めろ
lines.en: I want us to move forward with greening the office.
lines.style: Direct and authoritative. Clear-cut delivery on the main clause. Measured pace. The tone of someone accustomed to being obeyed. No invitation for negotiation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の急な痙攣対応マニュアルを整備します
lines.en: Understood. I'll also prepare a manual for handling sudden health emergencies among staff.
lines.style: Respectful acceptance with added intent. Slight lift on the affirmative. Brisk, efficient tone. Shows he's already thinking ahead to potential protocols. Demonstrates competence without overstepping.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員食堂で嘔吐事故が起きないよう衛生管理しろ
lines.en: Ensure the staff cafeteria maintains hygiene standards so incidents don't occur.
lines.style: Blunt, pragmatic instruction. Slightly raised volume on the verb. The matter-of-fact tone of someone stating what is obvious and necessary. No softening.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の眼鏡度数の補助制度も検討します
lines.en: Yes. I'll also look into creating a subsidy program for employee eyeglasses.
lines.style: Confirmed and building. Quick affirmation. Then a slight pause before listing the next initiative. Shows initiative without arrogance. Quiet determination underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、財務報告で積分的な指標を活用しろ
lines.en: Use integrated metrics in our financial reporting.
lines.style: Concise command. Clipped pacing. Weight on the key word. The voice of someone distilling complex strategy into essential instruction. Expectation built in.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。工場の水蒸気漏れ対策も徹底します
lines.en: Understood. I'll strengthen protocols for handling water vapor leaks in the factory as well.
lines.style: Swift acknowledgment. Steady tempo. Each point delivered with equal weight, showing nothing is overlooked. Demonstrates systematic thinking. Reliable and thorough.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、骨髄ドナー社員を支援しろ
lines.en: Support our employees who are bone marrow donors.
lines.style: Firm but with underlying humanity. Steady pacing. This one carries slight emphasis—the subject is serious and personal. Still a command, but one that shows values beyond profit.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の流暢な英語力育成も進めます
lines.en: Yes. I'll also advance our program for developing English proficiency among staff.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Slightly slower, showing the full scope of commitments understood. Respectful close. Demonstrates he has absorbed all directives and will execute them completely. Steady resolve.
